combos.name: Riposte
combos.use: Straight after a parry, when the foe's blade is still wide.

combos.name: Rising Fang
combos.use: After a dodge, coming back in from the side.

combos.name: Armor Splitter
combos.use: Against heavy plate. The last cut cracks posture.

combos.name: Crossbreaker
combos.use: Alternating angles slip past armour entirely.

combos.name: Mirror Step
combos.use: A quick diagonal figure when the seam runs corner to corner.

combos.name: Falling Crown
combos.use: On a staggered foe. Slow, hungry, and it hurts.

combos.name: Reversal
combos.use: Flows out of a dodge. Four cuts, finishing upward.

combos.name: Serpent's Path
combos.use: Needs a clean opening. Savage against a staggered foe.

combos.name: Eternal Edge
combos.use: Five cuts. Only when the opening is long and your arm is fresh.

combos.name: Twin Fang
combos.use: Dual blades only. Four cuts in the time of two.

combos.name: Whirlwind
combos.use: Dual blades only. Both diagonals, twice.

combos.name: Headsman's Due
combos.use: Axes only. Up, then all the way down.

combos.name: Timberfall
combos.use: Axes only. Two notches and the felling stroke.

combos.name: Colossus
combos.use: Greatswords only. The same blow twice, because once was not enough.

combos.name: Tidebreaker
combos.use: Greatswords only. Wide, wide, down, and tear it free.
